t: You're looking at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital, a 430-bed teaching hospital in Chelsea. It is the new site for the old Westminster Hospital, and it works closely with Imperial College London, teaching students and carrying out medical research. Several well-known people connect to it. Actress Dakota Blue Richards, who played Lyra in The Golden Compass, was born here. Dame Maggie Smith, the celebrated actress, died here, as did the actor Sir Ian Holm, the writer Anthony Shaffer, who wrote Sleuth, the actor Peter Wyngarde, and the Labour politician Lord Longford.
